pull_request.title: Infrastructure: build local ActsExamples extensions and migrate Python jobs
pull_request.head: codex/software-acts-examples
pull_request.body:
Third migration step, based on #78 and ADR-008. Builds the existing nODD DD4hep-to-ACTS/Gen3 adapter from software/source/ActsExamples, moves Python jobs to software/running and the independent source/surface audit to software/analysis. A CMake project hook appends local targets after upstream ACTS targets exist, preserving a clean ACTS checkout and ACTS source-revision metadata. The existing local Python sensitivity helper is retained in this extension rather than patched into ACTS Core.

The Makefiles create a build-owned Spack-Python environment with upstream generator requirements and the ACTS-local codegen package. Build, install and job outputs remain under nODD/build; the existing acts-nodd checkout and installation are preserved. DD4hep dictionary initialization is explicit before loading local factories.

Validation: a clean ACTS+extension build passed; 10 adapter/sensitivity tests passed, including complete tracker Gen3 construction and an 8-track Geant4 material-recording smoke job. The Python steering job completed 128 straight tracks with 45,646 sensors and 117 volumes. Independent native comparison passed with zero errors, unique IDs and all seven tracker systems. The detector suite passed 10/10; project-record tests 28/28 and token tests 10/10 passed. Source-ownership/session/project/token validation and token preview passed.

Merge after #78. The next PR migrates the existing calorimeter, jet and EDM4hep code into this same source ownership model. No scientific detector parameter or accepted reference output is changed.

events.text: Infrastructure: isolate dependencies, detector sources and ActsExamples jobs — see the canonical narrative for outcomes and checks.

Explicit fallback SoftEng assignment `CAL114-Accounting`, from the campaign
coordinator, source main `cd3ec20da56537617ac6fbbcf28bd6f28104cc64`.
The worktree `codex/calorimeter-campaign-record` began clean. The paired journal
was created after this assignment's own recovery-tool edits, so its captured
`initial_changes` accurately lists those edits; no unrelated edits existed.
Read the full prepared mandate and relevant repository/logging/interaction
instructions. No delegation, remote mutation, scientific source edits, package
installation or human sign-off was performed.

The user asks to preserve work, tokens, interactions and PR identities when
consolidating ECAL70/71/73/74/75 with issue114, and to prepare HCAL/FCAL PRs.
The coordinator's initial historical recovery failed because the client had
compressed archived `.jsonl` paths into `.jsonl.zst` without updating the stored
plain paths. This assignment fixes that infrastructure boundary and recovers
only allowlisted usage evidence.
